THE QUILTBOROUGH FIELD GUIDE

Cozy, with a chance of chaos.

Explore a kingdom stitched from blankets. Rescue six golden buttons and bring them to the fort to switch on its wishing lights!

WASD / arrows

Space / ↑

E / action button
Play, snuggle, throw, ride or tickle

Pillow Toss: Play from the peach mat. Throw when the aiming ring turns mint to catch the moving basket. Five hits in 40 seconds wins a badge. You can always try again.

Bedtime blizzard: The wind wakes Snooze! Hide inside the fort, jump over his hugs, or get close and tickle him. If he catches you, enjoy a silly blanket-burrito ride. No lives or buttons to lose.

Eight little Snoozes: Meet Pip, Doodle, Mochi, Button, Noodle, Pebble, Pudding and Wisp. Get close and tickle them to make a little friend who follows you. They are gentle, even in a storm.

Snuggle & peekaboo: Find the pink blanket near the welcome quilt. Tuck yourself in, and all eight kids gather around. Tap the action button or press E to play peekaboo! Walk, jump, or choose Hop out when you’re ready. You’re safe from Snooze while snuggling.

More soft surprises: Step on the springy pink quilts for a giant bounce. Ride the mint flying blanket for a tour above the kingdom. Collect all four cozy badges!

Progress lasts for this visit. Welcome quilt keeps your discoveries. Sound is optional, and menus pause the world.
